# Clipper

`clipper.js` vendors npm `clipper-lib@6.4.2` (internal version 6.4.2.2), retrieved using `npm pack` with registry integrity verification.

Original tarball SHA-512 (base64):
`knglhjQX5ihNj/XCIs6zCHrTemdvHY3LPZP9XB2nq2/3igyYMFueFXtfp84baJvEE+f8pO1ZS4UVeEgmLnAprQ==`

Adaptations: replace the UMD/global wrapper with a named ES module export, use runtime browser detection compatible with Node, and throw geometry errors instead of showing browser alerts. The geometry algorithm is unchanged. Copyright notices remain in the source. Boost and JSBN license texts are included alongside it.
